integrity: Proof uses exact Gaussian moments and a nonnegative coefficient identity; the included standard-library checker reproduces the whole fourth-moment polynomial coefficientwise. No computational sample is used as a substitute for the analytic tensor bound.
scientific_limitations: The sharp lower endpoint and five-term deficit concern only the real order-four Wiener chaos generated by two independent standard Gaussians. No extension to higher dimension, other orders or complex chaoses is claimed. The upper endpoint is also implied by standard contraction inequalities. Historical originality remains subject to independent verification.
title: Sharp fourth-moment interval and an exact deficit for binary fourth Wiener chaos
